reviewContext.userProblem: The production vactr editor still renders through CodeMirror EditorView (15 production files import @codemirror/view), visuals follow message receipt or raw AudioContext.currentTime instead of audible time, native output latency is always 'unavailable', the Tauri shell has no IPC or iOS project, and there is no real-browser evidence. The user wants a GPU canvas code editor for browsers and iPad with audio-clock synchronized visuals, bounded resources and measured evidence.
requiredOutcomes: Design amendment 15.3.8 covering song mode, completion popup, format/syntax migration, frame scheduler and backgrounding, ABI batch bounds and incremental deltas, and the measurement protocol with numeric thresholds (accepted; committed in this checkpoint).
WebGL2 canvas renders code text, cursor, selection, syntax, diagnostics and playing highlights; DOM is only the input, IME, clipboard and accessibility bridge (CANVAS-RENDER, CANVAS-MOUNT).
One headless EditorState authority with revisions and undo/redo; zero @codemirror/view or EditorView in production editor/src, enforced by editor/test/canvas/no-editor-view.test.ts (CANVAS-MOUNT).
Formatting, completion, evaluation, parameter editing/binding, diagnostics and song mode work on the canvas surface, with ported tests that keep their assertions (CANVAS-MOUNT).

AudibleClock with output-timestamp or probe correlation, epochs, staleness hide and late-frame recovery without drift or replayed flashes drives highlights, the transport bar, scopes, Hydra and video (CANVAS-CLOCK, CANVAS-VISUAL).
Native CPAL output-clock correlation publishing real latency provenance and a Session Protocol clock-probe; audio callback adds only a non-blocking record call (CANVAS-NATIVE).
Tauri desktop Session Protocol IPC tier and a Tauri iOS project built and launched on an iPad simulator with audio-session glue, or an exact blocker recorded (CANVAS-SHELL).
Animation-only frames do zero shaping, atlas uploads and buffer uploads; per-frame atlas budget, caps and disposal are tested (CANVAS-RENDER).

Playwright-library harness in Chromium and WebKit with behavioral checks and measurements on a 20,000-line ~1 MiB document, harness-written evidence in design-docs/specs/design-canvas-editor-evidence.md, honest limitations and pending physical-iPad procedures, final gates and closeout archival (CANVAS-EVIDENCE).
